name: markora-extension-toc
description: Optional generated table-of-contents support for embedded Markora editors.
author: Kevin Wang

scripts.build: node ./scripts/cleanDist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/copyStyles.mjs && node ../../scripts/fix-node-esm-specifiers.mjs dist
scripts.prepack: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke:node-esm
scripts.smoke:node-esm: node --input-type=module -e "const mod = await import('./dist/index.js'); if (typeof mod.createTocExtension !== 'function') throw new Error('createTocExtension export missing'); if (!Object.isFrozen(mod.defaultTocMessages)) throw new Error('frozen defaultTocMessages export missing');"
